title: GoPro HERO Session Waterproof Action Camera 1080p Tested Working w/ Mount Japan
condition_description: Pre-owned, tested: powers on and menus work. Light scuffs on the body and frame from normal use. Lens cover clean, no cracks.
description_html:
GoPro HERO Session (CHDHS-101) - pre-owned, tested and working.

  • Powers on and the menus work (see the photo of the status screen).
  • Lens cover is clean with no cracks.
  • Normal signs of use: light scuffs on the body and frame (see photos).
  • Built-in battery (non-removable). Battery life: not measured.
  • Waterproof to 10 m without a housing when new; seals are original, so waterproofing is not guaranteed on a used unit.

Included: GoPro HERO Session camera, frame, quick-release buckle mount and thumbscrew. No microSD card, no cable.

Ships from Japan with tracking. Please ask if you have any questions.
